metadata.description: Personal library of Claude Code agents, skills and MCP servers, packaged as installable plugins.

plugins.name: email-orchestrator
plugins.description: Cross-provider email assistant: briefings, auto-categorization, unanswered-email alerts, phishing detection, confirmed inbox cleanup, and approval-gated drafting and sending across Gmail, Outlook, and other connected mail services.

plugins.name: doc-skill
plugins.description: Writes a structured document (Title, Summary, Scope, Details or Step by step, Additional considerations, References) about the process just carried out in the conversation or about any topic you name, and saves it as PDF, HTML, MD, TXT or DOCX.

plugins.name: iac-azure-agent
plugins.description: Plain-English Azure infrastructure in Bicep with an approval-gated workflow. In development (Milestone 2 of 6): repository setup, adaptive requirements discovery and architecture proposals; no Bicep generation, GitHub publishing or Azure deployment yet.
